explanation: D2 is always the highest step: about 10 when S2 is reached by a rare transition (after choosing a1), 8-9 when S2 is reached by a common transition, 7-8 when S1 is reached by a common transition, and only about 4 when S1 is reached by a rare transition (after choosing a2). D1 and GO depend on which action the agent has been choosing: during a run of a1 choices D1 is about 5 after a reward and 7-8 after no reward, with GO at 2-4; during a run of a2 choices D1 is 0-1 after a reward and 2-3 after no reward, with GO at 0-1.
